function.name: GET_REAL_POINT
function.param: Number of point of control (0 is the center)
Offset of a variable of entire type (INT) which will have the horizontal coordinate of the point
Offset of a variable of entire type (INT) which will have the vertical coordinate of the point
function.abstract: It allows to obtain the position in screen of a point of control

description.p: This function allows to obtain the position in screen of a point of control of a graph contained by the current process, considering the variables that indicate the aspect or position of the graph, like , or .
The variables whose offset receives this function will have the coordinates of the point of control over screen.
